en: The postcard displays a black and white photo of a harbor scene with a large steamship decorated with flags docked at a wooden pier. People are gathered on the pier, and several buildings are visible in the background with a hill rising behind the city. The word 'Sundsvall.' appears on the top left, and 'Hamnen.' (Swedish for 'the harbor') appears on the top right. The reverse side shows handwritten text, including an address to a recipient in Swedish script, and the printed word 'BREFKORT' (old spelling of the Swedish word for postcard) and 'CARTE POSTALE.'
